   Claude understands your codebase, makes edits with your permission, and
   executes commands — right from your terminal.
   [1mShortcuts[0m
   ! for shell mode      double tap esc to clear       ctrl + shift + _ to
   / for commands        input                         undo
   @ for file paths      shift + tab to auto-accept    ctrl + z to suspend
   /btw for side         edits                         ctrl + v to paste
   question              ctrl + o for verbose output   images
